heading: Thursday, August 14, 2025
topLine: Generative AI designs antibiotics that clear drug-resistant gonorrhoea and MRSA in mice. Also: Meta releases DINOv3 self-supervised vision model.

items.headline: Generative AI designs antibiotics that clear drug-resistant gonorrhoea and MRSA in mice
items.summary: James Collins's group at MIT used generative models to produce more than 36 million candidate molecules, screened them computationally, then synthesised and tested the best: NG1 cleared drug-resistant Neisseria gonorrhoeae and DN1 cleared an MRSA skin infection in mouse models, both structurally unlike existing antibiotics and apparently acting on bacterial membranes. Published in Cell; the compounds need years of optimisation and clinical testing.

items.headline: Meta releases DINOv3 self-supervised vision model
items.summary: DINOv3 is a self-supervised vision backbone scaled to 7B parameters and trained on about 1.7B unlabeled images, with smaller distilled ViT and ConvNeXt variants. Meta reports state-of-the-art dense-prediction results with a frozen backbone and released training code and pretrained models under a commercial license.
